run_few_shot_qa: run the few_shot_qa function to answer a question using few-shot prompting with OpenAI
run_single_request: run a single few-shot QA request against the OpenAI backend and print the answer
run_streaming_response: run a few-shot QA request with streaming enabled and iterate over streamed tokens
run_batch_requests: run a batch of few-shot QA requests in parallel and print each answer
set_openai_backend: set the default sglang backend to OpenAI with gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct model
